new_findings.evidence: Reasoned from the code at bcc0688, not executed. Kept page two '/Resources << /Font << /F1 6 0 R /F3 50 0 R >> >>', content 'BT /F3 12 Tf ET' (no Tj or TJ); 50 = '<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type3 /FontBBox [0 0 1 1] /FontMatrix [1 0 0 1 0 0] /CharProcs << /a 51 0 R >> /Encoding << /Type /Encoding /Differences [97 /a] >> /FirstChar 97 /LastChar 97 /Widths [1] /Resources << /XObject << /Im1 10 0 R >> >> >>'; 51 = stream '1 0 d0 q 1 0 0 1 0 0 cm /Im1 Do Q'. Tf (:776) -> lookup Font /F3 = 50, kind_of Plain (not a stream, no OC), draws('Font', Plain) true, drawn => push(50, true) :790; traverse(50, true): type3 && Resources => Scope { streams: [51], certain: true } :715; read_scope reads 51: Do /Im1 => lookup => 10, drawn, push(10, true). 10 is certain and live (through 50's /Resources), not reported, region_flattened() true. No text is shown, so no viewer runs glyph procedure 51; the same holds for every glyph code that no show operator uses, because /CharProcs lists every glyph of the font. Also: gs naming that dictionary under /ExtGState (kind Plain is accepted by draws('ExtGState')) runs the same scope; scn/SCN naming a tiling pattern that nothing then paints and gs setting a soft mask that nothing then paints are treated as draws (rendered_with :796-799 pushes the soft-mask group certain). The lead's rule is an executed draw; selection is not one (for text: the show operators), exactly as the lead closed the unselected /AS states in R17b. R17-P3 recorded this edge as INFO because it looked consistent; it is a fail-open route, not only a coverage gap.
new_findings.remediation: Either (a) fail closed: read Type 3 glyph procedures (:709-717, :806-811) with certain = false unless the scope shows text after the Tf (a text-showing operator before the next Tf or ET), and treat scn/SCN and gs as draws only when a painting operator follows (over-reporting a Type 3 font that draws an XObject is acceptable per the lead); or (b) if the lead keeps selection as a draw, state it in flatten_purge.rs:64-68, sanitized_save.rs:186-207 and lib.rs:95 as a stated residual ('a Type 3 font selected by Tf counts as drawing every glyph procedure, shown or not'). In both: draws('ExtGState') must refuse a dictionary with /Subtype /Type3 and draws('Font') must refuse a dictionary with /Type /ExtGState (Kind::Plain conflates them). Tests: the Tf-only trace above (reported), the same with a Tj after the Tf (silent), gs naming a Type 3 dictionary (reported), the SCN spelling (closes R17-P3).
